notes.title: Patch note #4 - linux and macOS support
notes.notes: Jump the Track is now available for Linux and MacOS users!

notes.title: Minor patch note #3
notes.notes:

notes.title: Small patch note post-launch
notes.notes:

Fixed some bugs linked to debug options
Fixed some typos in the narration in English & French
